File No. ...
Section 2, Special Branch/djoh/
REPORT
Date... May ... 9, ... 19 36.

Subject... Communication dated 30.4.36 from the Netherlands Consulate-
General concerning: N. L. SENDEROFF.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by I. S. J. (sign)

Enquiries show that Naum Lazarevitch SENDEROFF is a
Russian of Jewish origin who was born on January 6, 1889, at
Kiev, South Russia. He is reported to have arrived in
Manchuria from the U.S.S.R. some time in 1928 or 1929 and to
have been conducting a small jewellery shop in Harbin together
with his brother. In 1930 they arrived in Shanghai from
Harbin and have since been residing in this city. They first
were partners in a similar business with I. A. Ilitovitch,
who at present owns a jewellery shop at No. 867 Avenue Joffre.
Owing to some disagreement over business matters a quarrel
arose between N. L. Senderoff and Ilitovitch which resulted
in the former individual being charged before the Second
Special District Court with "threats and insults" and sentenced
to $20 fine or 10 days imprisonment on 28.11.33.

After severing his connections with Ilitovitch, N. L.
Senderoff is reported to have been conducting a small business
of his own at 719 Avenue Joffre until about eight months ago,
after which he has been dealing in watches, precious stones etc.
on a commission basis. It is also reported that he is frequently
seen at Hai Alai games in the Auditorium. His present
address is No. 915 Avenue Joffre.

On two occasions in 1931 and once in 1933 Senderoff was
issued by the local Bureau of Public Safety passports to enable
him to proceed to Harbin and on September 10, 1931 he obtained
from the same Bureau Foreign passport No. 447 good for travell-
ing to Germany, France and return. However, enquiries show
that there is nothing in records of the local French Consulate
regarding Senderoff having been issued with any visas and it
is not likely that he obtained a German visa in Shanghai.

日期... 1936年5月... 9日...

主题... 荷兰总领事馆1936年4月30日来函，涉及：N. L. SENDEROFF。
由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报 经 I. S. J. （签名）转呈

经查，Naum Lazarevitch SENDEROFF 系犹太裔俄国人，1889年1月6日出生于南俄基辅。据报他于1928或1929年间某时从苏联抵达满洲，并与其兄弟在哈尔滨经营一家小型珠宝店。1930年他们从哈尔滨抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。起初，他与 I. A. Ilitovitch 合伙经营类似业务，后者目前拥有位于霞飞路867号的一家珠宝店。由于在商业事务上发生分歧，N. L. Senderoff 与 Ilitovitch 之间发生争吵，导致前者被第二特区法院以“威胁和侮辱”罪名起诉，并于1933年11月28日被判处20美元罚款或监禁10天。

在与 Ilitovitch 断绝关系后，据报 N. L. Senderoff 在霞飞路719号独立经营小本生意，直至约八个月前，此后他一直以佣金方式从事手表、宝石等交易。另据报，经常有人在 auditorium（原文不清，可能指某娱乐场所或礼堂）的海莱（Hai Alai）赌局中见到他。他目前的地址是霞飞路915号。

1931年两次及1933年一次，本地公安局向 Senderoff 签发护照，以便其前往哈尔滨；1931年9月10日，他从同一机构获得第447号外国护照，有效期涵盖前往德国、法国及返回的行程。然而，调查显示，本地法国领事馆的记录中没有任何关于向 Senderoff 签发签证的内容，且他不太可能在上海获得德国签证。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AC. HOLLANDIA.
No. 1660.

SHANGHAI, 13th May 1936 .

Sir,

I beg to acknowledge receipt of your letter of the
9th instant, No. D. 7393, regarding I. L. Senderoff, and to
thank you for the information contained therein.

On account of the unfavourable information and his
close connection with S. A. Brinberg, a visé for admission
into the Netherlands Indies will be refused.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Consul-General .

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1511.

SHANGHAI, 30th April 1936 .

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Naum Laseroff
SENDEROFF has applied to this Consulate General for a visé
for admission into the Netherlands Indies.

He is in possession of a passport,No.5936/259518,
issued by the Commissioner of Public Safety at Shanghai on
the 17th May 1935 valid only for Dairen, Japan and back.

According to this passport he is born at Kiev, 6th
January 1990.

He states to be living at 915 Avenue Joffre and to do
business in jewels and watches.

He intends to visit his niece Mrs.M.J.Mizrahi née
Rikoff who is residing in Sourabaia, and whose husband has
an Im- & Export firm "Java China Trading Co." at Sourabaia.

Senderoff called at this Consulate in company of
Szmul Mowsza BRINBERG, who also intends to visit Mrs.M.J.
Mizrahi. In November 1935 Brinberg applied already for a
visé, however on account of his former activites in the
illicit drug traffic in the Far East, a visé was refused.
(Vide your letters No.D.6254, 27th November 1934,No.D.4841,
10th December 1935).

know, if possible, whether anything is known against Sen-

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话：AD. HOLLANDIA。

第1511号。

上海，1936年4月30日。

先生：

谨此通知您，Naum Laseroff SENDEROFF 已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

他持有1935年5月17日由上海公安局局长签发的第5936/259518号护照，仅有效用于前往日本大连及返回。

根据该护照，他出生于基辅，出生日期为1990年1月6日（原文如此，疑为1890或1889之误）。

他自称居住在霞飞路915号，从事珠宝和手表生意。

他打算探望其侄女 M.J. Mizrahi 夫人（娘家姓 Rikoff），后者居住在泗水（Sourabaia），其丈夫在泗水拥有一家进出口公司“Java China Trading Co.”。

Senderoff 在 Szmul Mowsza BRINBERG 的陪同下到访本领事馆，Brinberg 也打算探望 M.J. Mizrahi 夫人。Brinberg 曾于1935年11月申请签证，然而鉴于其此前在远东参与非法毒品贸易的活动，签证被拒。（参见您1934年11月27日第D.6254号信函，1935年12月10日第D.4841号信函）。

12
/
42

如蒙告知是否从政治或道德角度掌握任何对 Senderoff 不利的信息，本人将不胜感激。

此致

敬礼

T. Robertson 先生，
特务科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，

D.S.S. Grohofio.
J.L. ½

上海。

您的顺从仆人，

—中文秘书。
